evidence.note: Establishes a baseline: counts tests per suite and surveys test content across all three suites before building, giving a done-vs-remaining frame.
'Per-suite summary and c_testsuite failures' and 'Categorize failure types' — structured pass/fail view by suite and failure category, not just an aggregate count.
Full suite re-run ~20 times, consistently after significant changes across the entire horizon — a sustained regression/progress cadence.
Explicit regression detection: 'Debug regression 00176' and 'Check 20050607 regression' — catching previously-passing tests broken by new features.
Persistent ledger (ccc-project.md / MEMORY.md) written and updated repeatedly across the build, maintaining an evolving picture of state.
'List wacc/remaining failures' used to decide where to work next, allocating effort to outstanding failures.

reasoning: The agent maintains a structured, suite- and category-level picture of pass/fail (steps 137, 188), re-runs the full suite after nearly every significant change (~20 times across the horizon), and explicitly hunts regressions on specific previously-passing tests (steps 494, 803), using failure lists to target next work — matching anchor 8. It falls short of 10 because there's no visible per-change newly-passing/newly-broken delta accounting or explicit thrash/stall detection, and the raw pass counts aren't observable in the log.
